testimonials.name: Aria Montgomery
testimonials.text: The most peaceful dental visit I've ever had. The warm wood textures, gentle background music, and Dr. Takahashi's touch made me feel like I was in a high-end spa, not a dental chair.

testimonials.name: Kenji Tanaka
testimonials.text: I highly appreciate the Japandi minimalism of the clinic. But more than the gorgeous layout, Dr. Vance's holistic focus and painless biological approach solved my severe dental anxiety.
